title: Task run state
description:
The graph blackboard for one task run. Every node reads it and writes back its own slice; no node recomputes another node's field. Replaces state currently scattered across /tmp/findings-$TASK-r$N.json, $SUMMARY_PATH markdown, Jira comments, and env vars.

OWNERSHIP — the reason this file exists:
  cmd/classify  writes repo, classification              (nothing else may write them)
  cmd/gates     writes gates[*]
  cmd/reviewer  writes rounds[*] for kind=full
  cmd/recheck   writes rounds[*] for kind=recheck
  the driver    writes task_key, round, verdict, status, pr, deferred_findings

resolved-once fields: repo.base_ref and repo.base_sha are resolved exactly once, by classify, at run start. No later node re-derives a base. That is what makes the stale-local-main diff bug structurally impossible rather than a thing to remember.

task_key.description: e.g. SMG-3966. Written by the driver.

repo.description: Resolved ONCE by cmd/classify. Immutable for the rest of the run except head_sha/dirty, which classify refreshes on re-run.

worktree.description: Absolute path to the task worktree.

base_ref.description: The base to diff against. classify rejects a local branch name whose origin/ counterpart differs, so this is always the remote truth.

dirty.description: Uncommitted changes present in the worktree at classify time.

classification.description: Written by cmd/classify. Mechanical, from config/risk-paths.json + the diff. Never a model judgment.

risk.description: MAX over every rule matched by every changed file. Feeds cmd/reviewer -risk.

risk_reasons.description: Human-auditable derivation: which rule raised the tier and which file triggered it.

components.description: UNION of matched rule components. Feeds cmd/reviewer -component, which raises per-dimension floors. Validated at config load against cmd/reviewer's componentFloorPresets keys.

financial_paths_touched.description: OR over matched rules' financial flag. Second deterministic check behind the human PR gate, independent of tier (pr-raise.md).

client_only.description: True only when EVERY changed file matched at least one rule and ALL of its matched rules are presentation. Necessary but not sufficient for the reduced panel.

server_surface.description: Any changed file has a server_surface_extensions extension (.go/.java/.py/.sql/.proto/.tf).

migration.description: Any matched rule sets migration. Drives deterministic loading of migration-checklist.md.

gate_signals.description: Content-derived, not path-derived: changed LINES matching a gate_signals pattern. Any hit disqualifies the reduced panel — a gate/guard/flag decides whether something is allowed, which is a correctness surface, not presentation (PR 1298 precedent).

panel.description: Graded panel preset. required is ALWAYS true: no PR is ever raised with zero AI review. preset >= floor always holds; an override below the floor is rejected as INVALID_INPUT.

reduced.description: True only for the solo preset (client-only carve-out).

recommended.description: What the rules computed before any -panel override.

floor.description: Minimum the hard blockers allow. Money/critical/scaffold/unmatched floor at deep; gate signals, migrations, High risk, components and rule panel_floor pins floor at full.

overridden.description: True when -panel chose a preset at or above the floor.

reviewers.description: Seat list the preset resolves to; classify emits it as -reviewers so nobody hand-assembles the list.

human_pr_gate.description: risk == critical OR financial_paths_touched. When true the driver stops at Prepared PR (pr-raise.md).

recheck_min_severity.description: medium when components is non-empty (critical systems converge to zero MEDIUM-or-higher), else high. Feeds cmd/recheck -min-severity so rounds 3+ cannot silently run at the wrong bar.

skills.description: Deterministic resolution of the path-derived rows of tasker.md's skill-routing table.

reviewer_args.description: Ready-to-exec argv for cmd/reviewer. Invokers pass this through verbatim instead of assembling flags, so -risk and -component cannot be forgotten by a caller.

unmatched_files.description: Changed files no rule covered. They took unmatched_risk (fail-closed). A non-empty list is a signal to add a rule, not to lower the tier.

size.description: Diff-size evidence behind the preset. Only production_lines drives decisions.

flow_diagram.description: True when the reviewer is asked to emit a mermaid flow/state diagram: production_lines >= 150 AND (gate signals OR migration OR risk >= high OR components non-empty).

rule_panel_floor.description: Highest panel_floor pinned by a matched rule, if any.

rule_panel_floor_rule.description: ID of the rule that pinned rule_panel_floor.

gates.description: Written by cmd/gates. Deterministic checks with real exit codes — replaces prose phases that asked a model to run commands and paste output. A gate absent from this map has NOT run; there is no self-reported PASS.

output_path.description: Raw output on disk. The summary quotes this file, never a paraphrase.

metrics.description: Parsed numbers a gate produced, e.g. coverage_pct, mutation_score, max_bench_regression_pct.

rounds.description: One entry per review round, appended by cmd/reviewer (kind=full) or cmd/recheck (kind=recheck). This array IS the iteration state — new_finding_count here is what the next round's -max-new is computed from, replacing the hand arithmetic at iteration-protocol.md:131.

kind.description: Rounds 1-2 are full (round 2's re-audit is deliberate); rounds 3+ are recheck.

prior_findings_still_open.description: Non-zero escalates IMMEDIATELY, any round. A finding surviving its one dedicated fix round is a design problem, not a patching problem.

new_finding_count.description: NEW at-or-above-floor findings. Must strictly decrease round over round; the next round runs with -max-new = this minus 1.

max_new_allowed.description: The -max-new the driver passed, derived from the prior round. Recorded so the invariant is auditable.

round.description: Current round. len(rounds) once a round has completed.

status.description: Maps to the Phase 5 summary Status field. The summary becomes a rendering of this file, not a document composed from memory.

deferred_findings.description: At-or-below-floor findings logged rather than iterated. Rendered into the summary's Deferred findings section.
